title: Camila Cabello Joins KATSEYE for Gabriela Dance at Los Angeles Show
excerpt:
Camila Cabello surprised KATSEYE fans during a Los Angeles concert.
She joined Daniela Avanzini for the Gabriela choreography before the group resumed its set.
body_md:
KATSEYE's Saturday-night concert at Los Angeles' Crypto.com Arena featured an unexpected guest when Camila Cabello, formerly of Fifth Harmony, joined Daniela Avanzini onstage for the choreography to Gabriela.

The surprise came roughly six songs into the show. After early numbers including Hootie Frutti and Touch, the other performers briefly left the stage, giving Avanzini the opportunity to introduce Cabello. Avanzini asked whether the guest knew the Gabriela dance, and Cabello playfully suggested that she knew at least some of the moves.

The two then performed the song's recognizable choreography, including its hand movements, in front of the crowd. Cabello departed afterward, and the other KATSEYE members returned for a full performance of the single. The appearance was a special live-concert moment rather than an announcement of a new recorded collaboration.

KATSEYE performed as a quartet at the event, with Avanzini joined by Lara Raj, Yoonchae and Megan Skindiel. The concert also drew on the group's recent catalog with songs such as Pinky Up, Gnarly and Mean Girls, offering a survey of the material that has helped build its audience.

The appearance took place during the Wildworld tour, following a year in which several group members temporarily stepped away from activities to focus on mental health. KATSEYE has also been named as the recipient of the Group of the Year honor at Variety's 2026 Hitmakers event, adding to the attention surrounding the group's momentum.

The reported itinerary included another night at Crypto.com Arena, followed by a Phoenix stop and a December 1, 2026 tour finale at Ariat Arena in Fort Worth, Texas. Cabello's brief appearance gave the Los Angeles crowd a memorable crossover between performers associated with different generations of girl groups.
